candidates.label: Premise A
candidates.title: Ember Lattice
candidates.concept: A debt-bound adult dungeon salvager awakens a fracture-reading class inside the Hollow Meridian and must convert cultivation bottlenecks into tactical class evolutions before a buried boss reaches the surface lift.
candidates.engine: descending ember-vault zones, explicit Ledger XP and loadout pressure, Breath Seed cultivation, two-adult fault-and-bastion combat

candidates.label: Premise B
candidates.title: Skygrave Cartographer
candidates.concept: An adult storm-map thief climbs drifting skeletal dungeons whose routes consume memories, leveling a path-writing class while cultivating a finite inner compass.
candidates.engine: route discovery, memory inventory, aerial predators, rival expedition race

candidates.label: Premise C
candidates.title: Red Current Forge
candidates.concept: An adult failed weaponsmith dives into a flooded volcanic dungeon where defeated leviathans become modular gear and cultivation heat must be vented through cooperative combat.
candidates.engine: underwater floors, oxygen/heat resources, forge inventory, guild salvage rivalry

selection_reason: Highest combined system/action integration and clean causal staging. Its fracture vocabulary makes stats, cultivation, gear, boss anatomy, and party tactics visible in the same panel without UI overload.
